title: EFC students hold sit-in at Jean Lorougnon Guédé University in Daloa
location: University Jean Lorougnon Guédé (UJLoG), Daloa; sit-in reported in front of the university presidency.
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count or qualitative size estimate is reported in either article. Both reports reproduce the same university communiqué, so they form one origin and do not independently corroborate the threshold.

start_date.summary: Both reports attribute the sit-in to 10 December 2024.

location.summary: Sit-in occurred in front of the UJLoG presidency in Daloa.

organizer.summary: EFC students were involved; no named organization is identified. A student is described as leading, but this is not treated as a formal organizer.

state_response.arrests.summary: The university communiqué reports that one student was detained for public-order disturbance.

demands.summary: Articles link the protest context to a Ministry-directed policy integrating EFC students but do not quote the students’ actual demand; leave unknown.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance estimate or threshold evidence.

notes: L’Intelligent and KOACI both quote/paraphrase the same UJLoG communiqué dated 11 December, not independent coverage. The article says the administration requested police intervention; it attributes no violence by students. The state-policy link is contextual rather than an explicit demand reported from demonstrators.
open_questions: What exact change or remedy did the students demand, and was it directed to a state policy or university decision?
How many participants were present simultaneously at the sit-in?
Is the account based on the full UJLoG communiqué, and can that primary document be accessed through a permitted route?
Was any further gathering or continuation reported after 10 December?

title: SYNADES extraordinary general assembly at CHU Cocody on 7 December
location: Extraordinary general assembly at CHU de Cocody, Abidjan.
organizer: Syndicat national des ex-déflatés et contractuels de la santé et assimilés (SYNADES)
threshold_50_evidence: No number of attendees is reported for the 7 December assembly. This is a formal union meeting; the source does not establish a public protest or a 50+ crowd. The planned nationwide strike is a separate action and dispersed workers cannot be added as a single crowd.

start_date.summary: Article reports an extraordinary assembly on 7 December, then a strike announced to start 23 December.

location.summary: Assembly held at CHU de Cocody; strike announced nationwide in public health structures.

organizer.summary: SYNADES members and secretary general are identified.

demands.summary: Reported demands include unpaid salaries and allowances, pay/transport decree implementation and a health-risk indemnity.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No assembly attendance or public gathering size given; national worker coverage is not a single simultaneous crowd.

notes: The body reports SYNADES members held an extraordinary general assembly on 7 December and voted to reconduct the strike. It does not establish that the meeting was a public protest or that >=50 persons attended. The announced 23 December work stoppage is represented separately, not merged into this meeting.
open_questions: Was the 7 December union assembly a public protest/mobilization rather than an internal union meeting?
Did members articulate their demands at the assembly, or are the demands only the reported union platform?
Were any demands accepted or other state responses made?

title: Students reportedly disrupt schools in Sassandra to demand early holiday departure
location: Secondary schools in Sassandra (several institutions; same-place participants unknown).
scope: local; school disruption reported at multiple sites, simultaneity unknown
threshold_50_evidence: PresseCotedivoire reports school intrusions/disruptions and explicitly says a security source declined to give the number of detainees. No number of people at a single public gathering is reported, and activity at multiple schools cannot be added.

start_date.summary: Article reports multiple school disruptions during a Monday–Wednesday period in December; it dates an injured guard to 11 December but does not date the first action precisely.

location.summary: Sassandra schools, including named public lycées and a private college; no same-place crowd identified.

demands.summary: Students reportedly demanded early end-of-year holiday from school administrations; whether this is directed at state policy is unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: The source attributes a projectile injury to students on 11 December, but does not clearly establish whether the injured security agent was a state actor; violence against the State remains unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: Article reports students detained after a hearing in Sassandra on 12 December.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No one-site attendance count; a security source declined to provide detainee numbers.

notes: PresseCotedivoire body now confirms school incursions and class disruption; this remains a candidate lead, not a verified qualifying public protest. The demand was directed to school administrations and the relationship to state policy is unresolved. AIP snippet and AfricaCoeurNews search-only material are supplementary leads only; they do not establish a >=50 crowd.
open_questions: Can an accessible, permitted full contemporary source verify that a public gathering occurred on 10 December?
Were the students addressing the State or education policy, rather than school-level schedules?
How many participants were in one place at one time, and were demonstrations simultaneous across separate schools?
What happened after the reported arrests and were there any further gatherings?
Was the injured security agent acting for the State, and what type of security post did the individual hold?

title: SYNADES nationwide health-sector strike announced for 23 December
organizer: Syndicat national des ex-déflatés et contractuels de la santé et assimilés (SYNADES)
threshold_50_evidence: The article announces a five-day strike across multiple facilities but does not verify that it began or describe a public rally/picket. Workforce totals across facilities are not one simultaneous crowd.

start_date.summary: KOACI reports the union announced a strike beginning 23 December; actual execution is not confirmed.

location.summary: The announcement names public health facilities nationwide.

organizer.summary: SYNADES secretary general announced the action.

demands.summary: Reported demands include unpaid salaries and allowances, decree implementation, pay/transport revaluation and health-risk indemnity.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance or public event/picket described; no aggregation across healthcare sites.

notes: Only an announcement is documented; the body does not verify whether the work stoppage was executed or whether workers held any public assembly/picket. Kept separate from the 7 December AGM.
open_questions: Did the strike actually begin on 23 December and continue for five days?
Was there a public rally, picket or other single-site gathering, and how many people were present simultaneously?
What state response occurred, if any?
